claims.claim_text: This saved-data diagnostic finished successfully with all 450 blocks and original preservation/resource checks.
On first-cue-compatible and coarse-response/path-failure FIT/CAL groups, all available single-slot GT witnesses lower the original total objective; actual learned coverage remains much lower.
Hard-quality winner and strict same-path adequacy can disagree, but this disagreement is rare in the observed actual candidate sets; this is not native scorer behavior.

A finite single-slot witness improvement may have zero initial output-space quality derivative when that slot is not the current hard winner; this does not establish a shared-head parameter-gradient obstruction.
Actual CAL small quality improvements can coexist with protected harm and total-objective increases; ideal witnesses do not prove trainability, motion compliance or deployment gain.

manifest_negative_constraints: No new training, model forward, loss change, unfreeze or DEV/test/new data.
No oracle performance, causal root, intention, SOTA, unpredictability or reliable group CI claim.
Raw good counts are not GT-independent distinct-good counts; window p95 means are not formal motion gates.
Population coordinate gradients are not actual minibatch or shared-model parameter gradients.
Inline adversarial review by the same assistant is not external peer review.
Keep formal response study at 2/3 and wait for human discussion after completion.
